sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check current state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

# Agent
agent = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'b']
print(f"Agent: {agent[0]['boundary']}")

# Blue regions
sky = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'S']
print(f"Blue regions: {len(sky)}")
for s in sky:
    rows = [p[0] for p in s['boundary']]
    cols = [p[1] for p in s['boundary']]
    print(f"  rows=[{min(rows)},{max(rows)}], cols=[{min(cols)},{max(cols)}], pixels={s['pixels']}")

# Pink block
pink = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'P']
if pink:
    print(f"Pink: {pink[0]['boundary']}, pixels={pink[0]['pixels']}")

# Green blocks
green = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green blocks: {len(green)}")

# Try moving LEFT to spawn more blocks
print("\nMoving LEFT to spawn more blocks...")
for i in range(3):
    result = action(['LEFT'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    nodes = seg['nodes']
    agent = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'b']
    green = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
    print(f"  LEFT {i+1}: agent={agent[0]['boundary']}, green={len(green)}")
    if green:
        break

# If green blocks spawned, click them
if green:
    print(f"\nClicking {len(green)} green blocks...")
    for g in green:
        rows = [p[0] for p in g['boundary']]
        cols = [p[1] for p in g['boundary']]
        center_r = (min(rows) + max(rows)) // 2
        center_c = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2
        result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_r, 'col': center_c}])
        seg = current_frame.segmentation
        nodes = seg['nodes']
        green_count = len([n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N'])
        print(f"  Clicked ({center_r},{center_c}): remaining = {green_count}")
        if result.get('level_completed'):
            print("LEVEL COMPLETED!")
            break
    
    # Check state
    purple = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'p']
    white = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'W']
    print(f"\nAfter clear: purple={purple[0]['pixels'] if purple else 0}, white={white[0]['pixels'] if white else 0}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
